title: Evaluation of a Reindexed Junta Restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f\colon\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, let $P$ be a set of coordinates, and assign a sign to each coordinate in $P$. For every sign vector $y$ indexed by the coordinates outside $P$, the reindexed restriction of $f$ at $y$ equals the restriction evaluated on the assignment obtained by identifying those outside coordinates with the corresponding coordinates of $y$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued Boolean function on $n$ coordinates
$P$ is a finite set of coordinates among the $n$ coordinates
$z$ assigns a sign to each coordinate in $P$
$y$ is a sign vector of dimension equal to the number of coordinates outside $P$
